rules.statement: A mortgage for immovable property by a person who at the date of the mortgage is not the owner becomes valid, not merely as against him but also as against a bona fide purchaser from him without notice of the mortgage, when he subsequently acquires the ownership.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the passages from Voet (bk. 20, tit. 3, s. 6) and from Nathan (2, 1004) which are quoted in the judgment of Grenier J. in S. C. 385-C. R. Galle, 6,074 (14 N. L. R. 65), expressly negative this contention."
